services.desc: Embark on an unforgettable journey combining a scenic seaplane flight with an exciting day of snorkeling among Florida’s vibrant marine life. The Florida Keys are home to the world’s third-largest barrier reef. With its unique groove and spur reef structure, ancient 7,000-year-old corals, and over 150 dazzling fish species, this snorkeling site offers an extraordinary experience for beginners and seasoned snorkelers alike. Get up close with stunning marine life, from exotic tropical fish to graceful stingrays and colorful coral formations.
